name: GNS3 Server
what_it_is: GNS3 Server is a backend HTTP REST API service that manages network emulation by orchestrating Dynamips, VirtualBox, Qemu/KVM, Docker, VPCS, and IOU-based emulators. It does not emulate network protocols directly but coordinates the underlying emulators and interconnects virtual nodes via uBridge.
fault_injection: Config mutation (change device configurations via API)
constraints: IOU node support requires i386 libraries and is Linux-only
Docker node support requires the `script` program (bsdutils/util-linux) and is Linux-only
libvirt NAT cloud feature is Linux-only
Requires external emulator binaries (Dynamips, Qemu, VirtualBox) — none are bundled
uBridge is a mandatory dependency; without it no nodes can be interconnected
Router/appliance disk images must be separately obtained and are not included
docker_services: gns3-server (builds from local Dockerfile, exposes container port 3080 on host port 8001)
notable_absences: No built-in GUI — requires gns3-gui or gns3-web-ui as a separate client
No bundled router images or appliance images
No native protocol traffic generation — relies on emulated devices for that
No built-in packet capture UI — capture is delegated to external tools (e.g., Wireshark)
No Windows or macOS support for Docker nodes or IOU nodes
No metrics/observability endpoint — no Prometheus or SNMP exposure from the server itself
